chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Musa ibn Sa'dan, from Abdullah ibn al-Haytham, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Do not attach your garment to your body while it is wet and you are fasting, until you wring it out.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on wearing wet clothes while fasting according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* under the chapter on immersion for the fasting person, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) offers a practical juristic detail regarding the state of *junnah* (ritual bath) during Ramadan. It emphasizes the importance of removing excess moisture to prevent discomfort or distraction, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on *taharah* (purity) and *khushu* (focus) as integral components of the fasting experience.
